text:
jana: quick postmortem follow-up from INC-4822. we underestimated burst priming overlap. want a short, prioritized set of actions we can ship this sprint: telemetry by cohort, a tiny blast-cap, blackout enforcement, and a micro-rollback prototype.

own: agree. proposal: 1) cohort_kv_miss and cohort_error_rate emitted per rollout (tags: rollout_id, cohort) 2) server-side blast_cap attribute (default 3) enforced at ramp-time 3) CI lint blocking rollouts that overlap priming windows list 4) micro-rollback: pause -> revert flow.

nina: I'll add the metrics emission to rollout-service. ETA: 1 day. SQL for weekly flag scanner (draft):
```sql
SELECT flag, rollout_id, AVG(kv_miss) AS avg_miss, SUM(errors) AS errs
FROM rollout_metrics
WHERE started_at > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY flag, rollout_id
HAVING AVG(kv_miss) > 0.08 OR SUM(errors) > 5
ORDER BY avg_miss DESC;
```
useful for owners.

vik: Micro-rollback sketch: soft pause when (error_delta >=1.5% OR p95_delta >=150ms) for 3m; hard revert when condition persists 6m OR cohort_kv_miss > 0.12 immediate revert. default: auto on for self-serve, tenant opt-out for Dedicated. will prototype in 48h.

jana: also add a small blast_cap lint at PR time: reject flag PRs without `blast_cap` or `owner`. owner: owen. due: 3 days.

own: taking owner for lint + CI check. will add infra/jobs/priming_windows.yaml as source of truth and a pre-merge validator.

ops-bot: created ticket SAF-2201 "rollout-safety-mini" assigned to owen + vik + nina. CI job `rollout-safety-validate` scheduled.

nina: will also produce a CSV of flags missing owner or ramp metadata nightly and drop in `s3://reports/flag-outreach/missing.csv`. support can use that.

vik: plan for micro-rollback demo: (A) feature-flagged deploy behind ff-off, (B) 7-day shadow test with traffic replay w/ priming spikes, (C) evaluate false-positive rate. shadow owner: ops-sre. due: 14 days after PR.

jana: summary tracker rows: (metrics emission: nina, +1d), (blast_cap lint: owen, +3d), (micro-rollback PR: vik, +2d), (nightly CSV: nina, +1d), (shadow run: ops-sre, +14d). I'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups doc and create calendar reminders.

own: will add a short runbook snippet for on-call: 3 steps -> pause, gather traces, revert if hard rule.

deploy-bot: note: rollout-safety-validate job will run on PRs touching `rollout/*` and `flags/*`.

jana: thanks all. please paste PR links here so I can close follow-ups in tracker. ping if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
